your_book:
Jaleel's book had a broad up session on Thursday, October 29. Healthcare and quality names led: AZN +2.88%, NVS +3.22%, SPGI +2.52%, ABT +1.88%, ZTS +1.29%. The biggest single-day gains were LULU +4.37% and AOS +4.32%. LULU and ONON (+2.69%) rose in sympathy with Boot Barn and Crocs' better-than-expected results, not on company news. The weak spots were semis and software. AVGO fell 1.94% and NVDA 0.8% on worries that AI infrastructure costs and scarce capital could slow chip orders. ADBE slipped 0.66% after ServiceNow's results hit enterprise software. The book's overall unrealized gain stands at -0.61%.

The drift is in the names the model rates AVOID, which together make up 21.2% of the book. LULU's bounce doesn't repair a guidance cut, a fifth straight quarter of falling Americas comps and tariff-hit margins. RKLB (6.3% weight, -24.6%, QARP 40.1) rose 0.85% on peer earnings, and nothing about its own thesis changed. ABT is the second-largest weight at 10.7%, carries an AVOID verdict, and has a trimmed EPS guide. It is also up 20.9%, so price and rating are pulling apart. BSX (-12.9%) is guided flat through Q3, with the next catalyst on Feb 2. Watch NVDA into Nov 17 for export-license and AI-capex news.

attention.headline: Weakest rating, deepest loss
attention.note: At 6.3% weight, -24.6% and a QARP of 40.1 with an AVOID verdict, today's 0.85% gain was only peer sympathy, so the thesis needs a deliberate hold-or-exit decision.

attention.headline: Big weight, AVOID verdict
attention.note: At 10.7% of the book and up 20.9%, it is rated AVOID (QARP 56.2) while the risk flag is only mild, so the rating and the position size disagree.

attention.headline: Sympathy bounce, broken thesis
attention.note: Today's +4.37% followed Boot Barn and Crocs, while the guidance cut and five straight quarters of falling Americas comps remain unresolved ahead of Dec 9.
